transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Festival Sustainability Coordinator. Before we get into the details, I want to flag that I've got some concerns about the draft operating package — particularly the diesel generator and the mixed-waste bins from a sustainability standpoint. But let's go through the joint operations review properly. Can I ask each of you to report on your areas: electrical, permitting, transport, and accessibility? I'd like to hear any required changes before I make a decision on approval.

transcript.text: During this week's technical test, I measured the planned sound and lighting load and confirmed that the park service can only supply 125 amps, while the draft package requires 200 amps. The good news is that a certified 180 kWh battery trailer is available and can support the full concert load — but I haven't yet added its load schedule to the operations packet. I'll need to update the package with the battery trailer's load schedule before we finalize.
